What we do

Professional support for every stage of your building project

Our services are structured around the needs of homeowners, landowners and overseas clients planning to build in Sri Lanka.

House Construction

Construction of new homes with attention to workmanship, material quality, site coordination, safety and the approved design.

Architectural Design

Functional and attractive house planning developed around your land, lifestyle, budget, local climate and approval requirements.

Structural Design

Engineering design and detailing of foundations, slabs, beams, columns and other structural elements to support strength and stability.

Drawings and Documentation

Preparation and coordination of drawings, schedules and project information required for pricing, approvals and construction.

Renovation and Extensions

Planning and execution support for home extensions, alterations and renovations while considering the existing building structure.

Project Coordination

Coordination among the client, designers, suppliers and site team to improve communication and keep the project moving in an organised manner.

Aluminium Fabrication

Custom aluminium doors, windows, partitions and related fabrication work, coordinated to suit residential and small building projects.

Timber Works

Selected timber doors, windows, roof-related components, finishes and custom joinery completed with attention to fit and workmanship.

About the company

A young company built on engineering responsibility

Buwaneka Engineering and Construction (Pvt) Ltd provides professional, coordinated and practical building solutions in Sri Lanka. Our focus is on building trust through careful planning, transparent communication, sound engineering and responsible project delivery.

We mainly serve residential clients. This includes people living in Sri Lanka as well as Sri Lankans and foreign clients living overseas who need a reliable team to help design, coordinate and construct a house in Sri Lanka.

✓Architectural and structural requirements considered together
✓Clear communication with local and overseas clients
✓Professional attention to safety, quality and constructability
✓Solutions developed around the client’s budget and priorities
Who we serve

Designed for clients building in Sri Lanka

Whether you are nearby or managing the project from another country, we aim to make the process clearer and more dependable.

Homeowners in Sri Lanka

For families and individuals planning a new home, extension or renovation anywhere in Sri Lanka.

Overseas Sri Lankans

For clients living abroad who need organised local design, engineering and construction coordination.

Foreign Clients and Investors

For people seeking professional support to develop a residence or small property project in Sri Lanka.

Our process

A clear path from your idea to construction

Each project is different, but a structured process helps reduce uncertainty and improve coordination.

Initial Consultation

We discuss your land, project goals, space needs, budget range and expected timeline.

Concept and Design

Architectural planning is developed and coordinated with the structural requirements.

Cost and Planning

The scope, drawings, materials and construction approach are reviewed before site work begins.

Construction and Coordination

The project is executed with communication, supervision and attention to quality and safety.
